function.name: XADVANCE
function.abstract: It displaces the current process according to his angle

description.p: This function displaces the current process in the direction specified for the angle indicated like first paramater, the number of units indicated like second parameter.

We must know that the displacement sis made in extra units, and so it has limitations of precision. A displacement of 1 or 2 units can not reflect the differences between angles, so that it will not be effective. If you want to displace a process in arbitrary angles and only a few pixels, it will be necessary to use the variable so that the coordinates of the graph will be in units smaller than pixel, how it happens by default.
